summary: Karman Line Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting completion of its IPO and private placement. The company sold 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, raising $200 million, and issued 650,000 private placement units at $10.00 each to FDB II and underwriters. Net proceeds were deposited into a trust account held by Continental Stock Transfer Trust Company. Funds will remain restricted until a business combination or redemption, with a 21-month deadline to consummate a deal. The filing includes an audited balance sheet as of August 19, 2026. This is a SPAC IPO, indicating the start of its search period; watch for future acquisition announcements.
